canonical_name: No System and Information Integrity Policy
description: System and information integrity policy and procedures are not established.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing system and information integrity policy documentation, absence of flaw remediation procedures, malicious code protection procedures, and monitoring procedures.
